primary_sources.assessment: Published exact pi values use combinatorial counting methods; the selected 1e12 table is stated to have a Goldbach-project cross-check. Independent current TLS download matches the frozen compressed and decoded hashes and all five integer pi entries. The third li(x) column is approximate and is not used.
The public projection supplies first positions and aggregate counts. Its described global computation does not turn that projection into every repeated gap position in the required band.
The primary Nyman-Nicely 2003 publication studies first-occurrence and maximal gaps in a broad containing interval. It is not this task's complete local repeated-gap catalogue.

Official existing Python binding and wheel, not a new generation algorithm. Fresh PyPI metadata matches the recorded Windows cp39 wheel SHA256; installed numerical sources/binaries match the recorded official wheels.
Segmented Eratosthenes with wheel/bucket optimizations is existing machinery. No new sieve or general tool family is claimed.

conclusion: Task-local finite verification with explicit existing machinery and data. No mathematical novelty, new general mechanism or global prime-gap theorem is inferred from these bounded queries.
